question: Manik Saha, chief minister of Tripura, became Member of Legislative Assembly from ______ constituency in by - election held in June 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Town Bardowali.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manik Saha**, **chief minister of Tripura**, won the by-election held in** June 2022** from the **Town Bardowali constituency.**
 
• Manik Saha was appointed as the chief minister of Tripura on **10 March 2022,** following the resignation of the previous chief minister **Biplab Kumar Deb.**
 
• The by-election in the Town Bardowali constituency was held after the resignation of the sitting MLA, **Sudip Roy Barman,** who joined the BJP after leaving the Trinamool Congress.
 
• The Tripura Legislative Assembly has a total of** 60 seats**, out of which 59 are elected and one is nominated.
 
• The current ruling party in Tripura is the **BJP, **which won a majority in the 2018 assembly elections by winning **36 out of 60 seats.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Gakulnagar constituency** is located in the **Dhalai district of Tripura**.

 
 
• It was won by the **BJP candidate** in the **2018** assembly elections.
 
 
 
• **Agartala** is the capital city of Tripura.
 
 
• It has** two** assembly constituencies, **Agartala and Agartala West.**
 
 
 
• **Belonia** is a city in the** South** Tripura district of Tripura.
 
 
• It has **one** assembly constituency, Belonia.
